title: payments.v1.PaymentCaptured
description: Money has actually moved. This is the point of no cheap return: the only way back is a refund, which the customer sees on their statement. Everything before capture is reversible invisibly; nothing after it is.

amount.description: Amount captured in this event. Partial capture is permitted by the ledger invariant (sum of captures <= authorized) but the fulfilment saga only ever captures in full.

captured_total.description: Running total captured against this payment after this event. Lets a consumer detect partial capture without replaying the whole topic.

ledger_entry_id.description: The append-only ledger row this capture wrote. The audit anchor: given this id, the exact financial record can be produced.
